[[40 BBY]] and [[32 BBY]]{{SW|url=news/marvel-darth-maul-black-white-and-red-reveal|text=Marvel's ''Darth Maul – Black, White & Red'' Coming April 2024 - Exclusive}} reveals ''Star Wars: Darth Maul – Black, White & Red'' occurs during Darth Maul's apprenticeship to [[Darth Sidious]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places between the estimate of 40 BBY and the date of 32 BBY. |series=''[[Star Wars: Black, White & Red]]''{{SW|url=news/marvel-boba-fett-black-white-and-red-announce|text=Put a Bounty on Marvel's ''Star Wars: Boba Fett – Black, White & Red'' - Exclusive Reveal}} |preceded by=[[Star Wars: Darth Vader – Black, White & Red]] |followed by=[[Star Wars: Boba Fett — Black, White & Red]] }} '''''Star Wars: Darth Maul – Black, White & Red''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] anthology miniseries by [[Marvel Comics]] featuring the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Maul|Darth Maul]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: Black, White & Red]]'' line. The [[Darth Vader – Black, White & Red 1|first issue]] was published on [[April 24]], [[2024]].
